messages:
emma: Anyone else seeing missing spans from background-job-prod? Root request traces exist but the worker child spans are gone for ~45m. Noticed after the midnight deploy. /cc @priya
sam: Hm. Which worker? prefetcher or batcher?
emma: prefetcher. service=background-prefetcher, K8S namespace=platform-jobs. Trace IDs show root span but no prefetcher spans. Links: https://dashboards.redwood/trace-search?service=background-prefetcher
priya: we rolled a config tweak to collector yesterday to change sampler from 0.05 -> 0.02 for prod to cut costs. Did we apply that to the OTLP sidecars too? @sam
sam: I rolled host-level change for the collector pool, not sidecars. Sidecars still use SDK default sampler (ParentBased(AlwaysOn)?)
devex-bot: Quick checklist for trace gaps: 1) confirm traceparent header propagation 2) check SDK instrumentation for background tasks 3) inspect collector sampling policies 4) look at OTEL_LOG_LEVEL debug logs
sam: if SDK uses ParentBased(AlwaysOn) it should respect incoming header. If the worker is starting a new root because it doesn't get trace headers, spans will be missing. Check the queue/processor code where we deserialize the job.
emma: Good point. Sample of our job handler header extraction:
```
def handle_job(msg):
    ctx = otel.propagators.extract(lambda k: msg.headers.get(k))
    with tracer.start_as_current_span("prefetch.process", context=ctx):
        ...
```
Looks ok but not sure if headers key names match (we use lowercase)
priya: Also check collector's probabilistic sampler config: https://config.internal/otlp/collector.yaml
priya: snippet from that file:
```
processors:
  probabilisticsampler:
    sampling_percentage: 2
    hash_seed: 1
```
sam: Try these quick checks: kubectl logs -l app=otlp-sidecar -n platform-jobs --tail=200 | grep "sampling"; kubectl exec -it svc/prefetcher -c app -- env | grep OTEL
ops-bot: Incident bot: Alert 'trace-span-drop-high' triggered for background-prefetcher (count 18) at 2026-03-18T02:07:32Z
emma: I ran the logs, sidecars don't report sampler overrides. Also confirmed our job queue library lowercases header keys; propagator expects 'traceparent' lowercase so should work. Maybe serialization strips headers on dequeue.
sam: Can you add a short debug around job enqueue to print headers? e.g., `print(msg.headers)` — let's avoid PII but print keys only.
priya: I'm going to temporarily set sidecar config sampling_percentage: 100 for one node pool canary for 30m and post results.
emma: Thanks. If that surface spans, we know sampling was the cause. If not, we look at header propagation in queue code.
sam: I'll follow up with a quick PR to add header-key debug and a runbook link: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/traces/missing-spans
emma: great, leaving it to you two. :thumbsup:
